name: cc-voice
description: Speak to Claude Code: press a shortcut, talk, and the transcript lands in the prompt box at the cursor

asr_base_url.title: Transcriber base URL
asr_base_url.description: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (the part before /audio/transcriptions), e.g. https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1, https://api.groq.com/openai/v1 or https://api.openai.com/v1

asr_model.title: Transcriber model
asr_model.description: Speech-to-text model at that endpoint, e.g. FunAudioLLM/SenseVoiceSmall, whisper-large-v3, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe

asr_api_key.title: Transcriber API key
asr_api_key.description: Key for the transcriber; left empty, the CC_VOICE_API_KEY environment variable is used

language.title: Spoken language
language.description: auto, or a language code the transcriber takes (zh, en, ja...). English (en) also switches the plugin's own messages to English

hotwords.title: Hotwords
hotwords.description: Terms you say often, comma separated (useEffect, Kubernetes, pnpm); passed to the transcriber as a hint and to the correction step

device.title: Microphone
device.description: auto (a real PulseAudio/PipeWire source, else the first ALSA capture device), pulse, pulse:<source>, or an ALSA device such as plughw:0,7

max_seconds.title: Longest recording (seconds)
max_seconds.description: A recording stops and is transcribed after this long (5 to 600)

fix_enabled.title: Correct transcripts with a chat model
fix_enabled.description: Sends each transcript to a chat model that fixes misheard technical terms and punctuation (about 0.5 to 1 s more)

fix_base_url.title: Correction base URL
fix_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for the correction step (the part before /chat/completions)

fix_model.title: Correction model
fix_model.description: A small fast chat model is enough

fix_api_key.title: Correction API key
fix_api_key.description: Left empty, CC_VOICE_FIX_API_KEY is used, then CC_TRANSLATE_API_KEY (shared with cc-translate)

fix_extra_body.title: Correction extra request fields (JSON)
fix_extra_body.description: A JSON object merged into every correction request. The default turns DeepSeek's thinking off; set it to {} for providers that refuse unknown fields
